name: Container RNG📦
desc:
A chill game where you buy mystery containers!

How to Play:
📦 Buy up mystery containers!
💥 Unbox rare items with crazy modifiers
💰 Sell for profit and unlock better containers
🚀 Buy upgrades to boost your progress
🎉 Show off your rarest finds to friends!

👥 Join the group for bonuses and updates
👍 Like the game!

👑 Can you find the rarest mutated item in the game?

⚠️BETA RELEASE (WIP) - MAY CONTAIN BUGS
✅ Supports PC, Mobile, and Tablet players
